extracted.summary: The Dr Ambedkar Scholarship is a centrally sponsored post‑matric scholarship for economically disadvantaged students from Class 11 to PhD levels, limited to permanent residents of Chandigarh.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: The annual household income must not exceed INR 2,50,000.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the EBC categories per the Government of India's list.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be enrolled in post-matriculation courses at recognised institutions.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be Indian citizens and permanent Chandigarh residents.
